 n=len(grid[0]); out=[[0]*n for _ in range(n)]; center=n//2
 for r in range(n):

  if r>=3:
   for c in range(n):
    if (c-r)%4==center%4 and out[r][c]==0 and (r>center or center-r<=c<=center+r): out[r][c]=1
 return out
')
